property_summary: For any bytes4 interfaceId equal to the ERC-165 id 0x01ffc9a7, c.supportsInterface(interfaceId) must return true (ERC-165 reflexive self-registration); the mutant drops the super disjunct so it returns false for that id.
change_summary: Remove the super.supportsInterface(interfaceId) disjunct, so the IERC165 interface id is no longer supported.
